system.description:
Category: Taijutsu

You’ve mastered the art of fighting while minimally armored, treating combat as an elegant dance. While you are wearing light armor or no armor, you gain the following benefits:

Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When an attack roll misses you, you can move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, and you gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. This AC bonus doesn’t stack with itself.

Once per turn, when a creature misses you with an attack, your next attack against it before the end of your next turn deals an extra 1d6 damage.
